<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 7"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Go With the Flow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5245) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="General" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=78" />
<trait label="Secret" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=142" />
<trait label="Skill" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=144" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 71

**Frequency**
Once per day

**Prerequisites**
Master in [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)

**Trigger**
A creature detects your attempt to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=2388), and you're within 30 feet of at least one other creature.

</column>

---

You have an occult connection to the world that helps you blend in with the cacophony of life around you. Attempt an Occultism check against the creature's Perception DC. On a success, the creature mistakenly identifies another creature within 30 feet of you as you instead.
name: Go With the Flow
primary_source_raw: Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall pg. 71
